def score(item: int, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Score each bin for assigning the current item. Higher score = preferred bin.

    Args:
        item: size of the current item to assign
        bins: remaining capacities of feasible bins (all >= item size)
    Returns:
        scores: priority scores for each bin
    """
    return -np.abs(bins / item - np.ceil(bins / item))
genes.thought: Your new algorithm scores bins by favoring those where the item fits "just right", i.e., balances the need to avoid excessive unused space and to maintain a diverse set of remaining capacities by emphasizing bins with remaining capacity close to a multiple of the item size.
